# Code of conduct

## Our pledge

We as members, contributors, and maintainers pledge to make participation in this project a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socioeconomic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment:

- Being respectful of differing opinions, viewpoints, and experiences
- Giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback
- Focusing on what is best for the community of candidates this project serves
- Helping newer candidates without condescension

Examples of unacceptable behavior:

- Harassment, trolling, insults, or derogatory comments
- Publishing others' private information without explicit permission
- Sharing or soliciting confidential exam content, which harms every credential holder
- Any conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting

## Enforcement

Maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing these standards and will take appropriate, fair corrective action in response to any behavior they deem inappropriate, including removing comments, discussions, or contributions and blocking repeat offenders.

Report unacceptable behavior by opening an issue or contacting the maintainer through their [GitHub profile](https://github.com/Amey-Thakur). All reports will be reviewed promptly and handled with discretion.
